subject: FYI: Global Prepositioning Stock Status - November 2025

body.content:
Sir,

Attached is the monthly status report for Army Prepositioned Stocks (APS) managed by SDDC. Overall readiness remains green at 94%.

Key highlights:
- APS-2 (Europe): 96% ready, rotation cycle on track
- APS-3 (CENTCOM AOR): 92% ready, container refresh in progress
- APS-5 (Pacific): 95% ready, sustainment operations normal

Minor challenges:
- Delayed shipping for 12 HEMTT trucks to Pacific APS (est. delivery Dec 15)
- Awaiting replacement water purification units for European stocks

All shortfalls are being actively managed and do not impact operational requirements.

Respectfully,
COL Michael Chen
Chief, Distribution Operations
SDDC
